t: This is the Royal Marsden, a specialist NHS cancer hospital. It has two sites, here in Brompton and another at Belmont in Sutton. Several well-known people died here. Philip Gould, who advised the Labour Party as a political consultant, died here, as did Denise Robertson, the agony aunt on This Morning for over twenty-five years. Shehu Abubakar, the Emir of Gombe in Nigeria, also died here, along with football club owner Ron Noades and the journalist David Walter.
